output.scope_note: The paper is about amorphous Li lanthanum titanate, a solid Li-ion electrolyte, and quotes its lithium ionic conductivity, but its own measurements are electronic conductivities, which are excluded.

records.evidence_quote: Amorphous lithium lanthanum titanate (aLLTO) was originally developed as a solid-state electrolyte with relatively high lithium ionic conductivity (~10-3 S/cm) and low electronic conductivity
records.notes: Value is quoted from prior work on amorphous LLTO (Li3xLa2/3-xTiO3), not measured in this paper. Temperature and method not stated. The tilde in the source is not part of the number.

records.evidence_quote: LLTO possesses higher ionic conductivity (~10-3 S/cm) than a conventional thin film solid state electrolyte, such as lithium phosphorous oxynitride (LiPON, ~10-6 S/cm).
records.notes: Value is attributed to the authors' earlier pulsed-laser-deposited amorphous LLTO film work (ref 45), not measured in this paper. Temperature and method not stated.
